setup.prompt: all 77 labels listed + 10 worked examples drawn from split_train (asserted disjoint from golden)
setup.decoding: greedy, max_new_tokens=12 - identical to the adapter run

notes: 84 of 770 outputs (10.9%) were not a valid label. Accuracy among well-formed outputs is 0.586, so roughly 0.064 of the 0.405 gap is formatting and roughly 0.341 is genuine classification ability.
macro_f1 0.349 vs micro 0.522 means the baseline is very uneven across the 77 classes - strong on some, near-zero on others. The adapter's macro and micro are within 0.001 of each other.

WEAKNESS TO DISCLOSE: the 10 demonstrations cover only 10 of 77 classes. A one-demo-per-class baseline (~3,000 tokens) would be a stronger comparison. The delta is large enough to survive that, but the baseline as run is not the strongest possible.

reproducibility.interpretation: Bit-identical across two runs on different Colab VMs. Greedy decoding over a fixed base model has no nondeterminism, so the evaluation harness itself is exactly reproducible.
